title: COMPUTER LABORATORY I
modules: Creating A Simple Network Using Packet
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a component within the system unit and it is not the only thing that makes up the system unit."
The CPU or simply processor is a component within the system unit and it is not the only thing that makes up the system unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the device used to read Compact Disc Read-Only Memory (CD-ROM)."
CD-ROM Disk Drive A CD-ROM drive or optical drive is the device used to read Compact Disc Read-Only Memory (CD-ROM).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most popular application programming languages which is easy to learn."
Visual Basic programming language is one of the most popular application programming languages which is easy to learn.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of summarizing a bunch of contiguous subnetted networks back in a single large network."
Supernetting is the process of summarizing a bunch of contiguous subnetted networks back in a single large network.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those devices which are attached to the system unit."
The computer peripheral devices are those devices which are attached to the system unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an expensive resource and as such requires adequate protection from electrical damage."
The computer is an expensive resource and as such requires adequate protection from electrical damage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the link between the PC's memory and the monitor."
The display adapter card is the link between the PC's memory and the monitor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a command which can show you the path a packet of information takes from your computer to one you specify."
Tracert is a command which can show you the path a packet of information takes from your computer to one you specify.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the identifier that allows information to be sent between devices on a network: they contain location information and make devices accessible for communication."
IP addresses are the identifier that allows information to be sent between devices on a network: they contain location information and make devices accessible for communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to provide a Physical Star Topology."
Hubs are used to provide a Physical Star Topology.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to distinguish the network portion from host portion in an IP address."
Subnet mask is used to distinguish the network portion from host portion in an IP address.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a type of networking hardware used to connect a network device to one or more other network devices, or to connect two or more devices to a single computer or network device."
Networking cables are a type of networking hardware used to connect a network device to one or more other network devices, or to connect two or more devices to a single computer or network device.
